subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should the gateway config mutation boundary stay unchanged for `channels.feishu.streaming`?
rationale: The source-level issue is clear, but the fix changes Feishu's public config shape and may affect the model-to-operator config mutation boundary.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current boolean defaults and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Only adjust progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu streaming boolean-only and reduce scary non-zero exec wording, which is smaller but still leaves no way to stream answers while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Add `channels.feishu.streaming` to the gateway mutation allowlist, which helps recovery but broadens an operator-controlled config path and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current boolean defaults and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Feishu Card Kit streaming path and current boolean streaming surface that this decision would extend.
